entries.name: Anthros
entries.content:
Anthros are an artificially created being in the form of anthropomorphic animals of various species that are the second class citizens of the people on Earth. They all have near-human levels of intelligence and walk bipedally. They are able to speak and write human languages.
The demography amongst anthros is diverse and varied. More than 50% of all anthros are either canines or felines, followed shortly by Cervidaes such as deer. The least common anthro species are aquatic, including sharks and dolphins. The majority of anthros are female, and all anthros are seen as below humans. Many Anthros are still used as their species, IE, Cow Anthros are used for the milk and beef industry, Deer Anthros are regularly hunted for sport, Chicken Anthros are used for the poultry industry.
